key.name: toggle-raven
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to show or hide the Raven sidebar. Change with: gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.raven-sidebar toggle-raven "['<Super>n']"

key.name: habits
key.description: JSON array of habits for the Habit Tracker widget. Each entry is { "name": string, "history": { "YYYY-MM-DD": true } }. Managed by the widget; not intended to be edited by hand.
